summary.text: Kim Pomerleau is a Republican state representative from Maine House District 85 who is running for Maine State Senate District 22 in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is not seeking re-election to the House.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and faces Democrat Nathan Burnett in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists her as Kimberly Pomerleau and says she lives in Standish, Maine.

She assumed office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, after defeating Democrat Christopher Struebing, 54.9% to 45.1%, in the November 2022 general election for District 85, and she won re-election in 2024.
Pomerleau served on the Elections Committee in the 2023–2024 and 2025–2026 sessions and on the State and Local Government Committee in 2023–2024.
